entries.gap: Under a limited initial budget, no retrieved frontier establishes that the observed low-fidelity score preserves the sign and ordering of paper interventions by the performance improvement they later produce on independently specified user tasks; a probe can therefore support the wrong go/no-go decision even when it is internally faithful.
entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often when the constructed instrument isolates the confound only inside an artificial regime and never demonstrates that the isolated signal transfers to real deployment conditions — the synthetic-to-real gap is asserted rather than shown. A second recurring shape is circularity: the diagnostic is validated against the same definition, assumption, or system population it was built to interrogate (using the evaluated models as their own oracle, or hardcoding a contested definition of the target property), so it cannot independently confirm what it claims.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A diagnostic that only re-confirms a shortcut already known in advance, surfacing no previously unmeasurable failure, is read as confirmatory rather than as a contribution.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The candidate could reveal previously unavailable adoption-sign errors, but its central comparison may instead reproduce the already documented weak relationship between cheap fidelity proxies and full outcomes without a distinct apparent-versus-de-confounded finding.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: The shared move is to construct a controlled set of evaluation instances in which exactly one named confound is either structurally blocked or independently varied, then report the divergence between apparent and de-confounded performance as the primary result rather than an aggregate leaderboard score. The headline finding is the measured gap itself (a transition that vanishes under a linear metric, a score that collapses when an irrelevant clause is inserted, an 87%-versus-37% split between pedagogical and production partitions), used to overturn a face-value reading of an existing measurement.
entries.instantiation_in_core_mechanism: Steps 1, 3, 4, and 5 freeze user cases and the oracle, then compare a selected operator with a sham under matched execution, so artifact-conditioned task generation is structurally blocked. However, no artifact-conditioned arm is independently varied against the locked-task arm and the primary output is a utility predictor rather than the C02-defining apparent-versus-de-confounded performance gap; moreover, Step 2 does not make operator selection independent of the inspected paper.

paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: The retrieved transportability framework makes population-level causal transport to a target population depend on explicit covariate-shift assumptions. ClaimProbe estimates a paper-specific treatment contrast on eight locked rows and then treats a leave-one-paper-out residual bridge from at most four papers as evidence about user-task adoption benefit, but it specifies neither the source-to-target selection mechanism nor covariates under which sign and rank are preserved; consequently its central utility claim stands or falls on an unestablished transport condition. Collision coverage is degraded, so this is the strongest retrieved threat rather than evidence that no closer exact-mechanism ancestor exists.
paper_pointed_threat.addressable_via: The core_mechanism and hook would need to define the target population, state testable selection-shift assumptions or a transport estimator, and restrict claims to the locked packet whenever those assumptions cannot be supported.
